heroDescription: A visionary philosopher and spiritual leader who dedicated his life to the betterment of humanity through introspection, meditation, and a profound understanding of the universe.
timelineTitle: Life Journey of Shri Vethathiri Maharishi
searchForKnowledgeDescription: Born in 1911 in the village of Guduvancheri, Maharishi from an early age sought answers to the profound questions of life: "What is God?", "What is life?", and "Why is there poverty in the world?". Despite being self-educated, his intense contemplation led to the development of his deep philosophy of life.
philosophyDescription: During his 40s, Maharishi's quest for knowledge expanded further as he started receiving deeper insights into the origin and functions of the cosmos. He wrote over 2000 poems, authored around 70 books, and traveled extensively to share his knowledge and teachings across India and the world.
spreadingMessageGloballyDescription: In the later stages of his life, Maharishi tirelessly propagated his vision of peace, fraternity, and love by spreading his knowledge to people across the world. His travels included Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, and the U.S.A. He addressed the United Nations in 1974, sharing his vision of peace and well-being.
legacyTitle: Service to Humanity and World Peace
legacyDescription: Shri Vethathiri Maharishi founded the World Community Service Centre in 1958 to bring about individual, family, and world peace. His teachings continue to spread across the globe, guiding people toward a harmonious life, free from negativity, and filled with compassion and love for all living beings.
wcscDescription1: Founded in 1958, the World Community Service Centre (WCSC) aims to inculcate individual peace that blossoms into world peace. With over 225 affiliated trusts, WCSC provides yogic practices that transcend barriers of religion, nationality, and gender.
wcscDescription2: The Centre continues to serve humanity by teaching meditation, Kundalini Yoga, and introspection techniques for a peaceful, successful life.
kundaliniTitle: Kundalini Yoga and Kaya Kalpa Research Foundation
kundaliniDescription1: In 1984, Maharishi founded the Kundalini Yoga and Kaya Kalpa Research Foundation at Aliyar. This foundation focuses on the spiritual well-being of humanity, and the Temple of Consciousness was constructed to spread his teachings further.
kundaliniDescription2: Today, the Vethathiri Maharishi Institute of Spiritual and Intuitional Education (VISION) and the "Brain Trust" help solve fundamental problems of society through intellectual engagement and spiritual awareness.
